_meta.warning: Passport/ID photo specifications are changed by governments without notice. Every entry below carries a sourceUrl. BEFORE SHIPPING, spot-check at least the top 10 markets against the official government page. Never claim 'guaranteed acceptance' anywhere in the app or store listing (Google Play Deceptive Behavior policy).
_meta.units: All dimensions in millimetres. dpi is the print resolution. head/eye percentages are fractions of the total photo HEIGHT measured from the BOTTOM edge unless stated.

countries.name: India
countries.notes: Passport: white background, no glasses, both ears visible where possible.

countries.name: United States
countries.notes: 2x2 inch. Head measured from chin to top of hair. White or off-white background. No glasses since 2016.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.notes: Plain light grey or cream background. Head 29-34 mm from chin to crown.

countries.name: Canada
countries.notes: 50 x 70 mm. Face height 31-36 mm. Plain white background.

countries.name: Schengen / EU
countries.notes: ICAO standard. Head 32-36 mm. Plain light background.

countries.name: Australia
countries.notes: Head 32-36 mm from chin to crown, plain white or very light grey.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.notes: White background, coloured photo, no white clothing.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.notes: Matte finish, white background, taken within last 3 months. Small file limit for online upload.

countries.name: Japan
countries.notes: Plain background, no border.

countries.name: China
countries.notes: 33 x 48 mm. Head width 21-24 mm, head length 28-33 mm. White background.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.notes: White background, taken within 6 months.

countries.name: Germany
countries.notes: Biometric, plain grey-white background.

countries.name: France
countries.notes: Light, plain, unicoloured background — not white.

countries.name: Brazil
countries.notes: 5 x 7 cm, white background, colour photo.

countries.name: Mexico
countries.notes: Horizontal 4.5 x 3.5 cm for some procedures; white background, no glasses.

countries.name: South Africa
countries.notes: White background, taken within 6 months.

countries.name: Nigeria
countries.notes: Plain white background.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.notes: 4 x 6 cm, white background, facing camera.

countries.name: Türkiye
countries.notes: 5 x 6 cm biometric, white background, taken within last 6 months.

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.notes: 4 x 6 cm. RED background is standard for many Indonesian documents — verify per document type.

countries.name: Philippines
countries.notes: 4.5 x 3.5 cm, white background.

countries.name: Bangladesh
countries.notes: 4.5 x 3.5 cm, white background.

countries.name: Pakistan
countries.notes: 35 x 45 mm, white or blue background depending on document.

countries.name: Sri Lanka
countries.notes: Plain white background.

countries.name: Nepal
countries.notes: Plain white background, recent.

countries.name: Italy
countries.notes: ICAO standard, plain white background.

countries.name: Spain

countries.name: Netherlands
countries.notes: Plain light grey, uniform background.

countries.name: Poland

countries.name: Sweden
countries.notes: Plain grey-white background.

countries.name: Switzerland
countries.notes: Plain light grey, no shadow.

countries.name: Israel

countries.name: Egypt
countries.notes: 4 x 6 cm, white background.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.notes: Plain white background, taken within 6 months.

countries.name: Malaysia

countries.name: Schengen Visa
countries.notes: Same ICAO geometry as EU passports; frequently requested separately.

countries.name: US Visa (B1/B2)
countries.notes: Identical geometry to the US passport photo. Online upload must be square, 600x600 to 1200x1200 px.

countries.name: LinkedIn / Profile
countries.notes: Not an official document — a convenience preset. 1:1 square, 800x800 px minimum.
